detail.longDescription: Moravian University: Moravian University Launches AI Lab to Model Ethical Innovation. “Moravian University announced the official launch of its AI Innovation Lab, a hands-on physical and collaborative space where students from any academic discipline can test ideas, learn emerging technologies, and build practical AI tools to address real-world challenges.” https://rbfirehose.com/2026/09/10/moravian-university-moravian-university-launches-ai-lab-to-model-ethical-innovation/
